title: jMonkeyEngine SDK 3.5 is available
content:
We are happy to announce the immediate availability of jMonkeyEngine SDK 3.5!

Highlights:
  • Engine version v3.5.2 used internally and by Ant projects.
  • Ant projects have sources and javadocs again.
  • A new Gradle project wizard for jumpstarting your jME journey
  • Scene Composer fixes and enhancements
  • Based on Netbeans 15
  • Comes with JDK 11.0.17
Please report bugs and improvement ideas to our project Github page GitHub - jMonkeyEngine/sdk: The jMonkeyEngine3 SDK based on netbeans.

Download your copy from SDK Release 3.5 today!
